description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for serializing and deserializing JavaScript values, including handling of typed arrays, errors, dates, URLs, and other complex objects, used within the Playwright project.

methods.name: isRegExp
methods.description: Checks if an object is a RegExp instance or similar.

methods.name: isDate
methods.description: Checks if an object is a Date instance or similar.

methods.name: isURL
methods.description: Checks if an object is a URL instance or similar.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if an object is an Error instance or similar.

methods.name: isTypedArray
methods.description: Checks if an object is a specific typed array.

methods.name: typedArrayToBase64
methods.description: Converts a typed array to a base64 string.

methods.name: base64ToTypedArray
methods.description: Converts a base64 string back to a typed array.

methods.name: parseEvaluationResultValue
methods.description: Deserializes a SerializedValue into a JavaScript value, handling references and complex objects.

methods.name: serializeAsCallArgument
methods.description: Serializes a JavaScript value into a SerializedValue suitable for remote calls.
